notes.overlap: manageengine.com is a URL-prefix property containing the product properties below it. Property figures must not be added together.
notes.query_grain: Query-level clicks and impressions exclude anonymised queries, which Search Console omits entirely from any query-dimensioned request. They rank reliably but under-count badly -- one probed day showed 66% of clicks missing. Page figures come from a separate page-grain pull and are correct.
notes.history: Page-grain history starts 2025-04-29; the Search Console API serves only a rolling ~16 months and nothing earlier can ever be recovered. ADAP has 2022-2025 history from an older export that under-counts, shown separately and never spliced on.

decay._note: Last 28 days vs the 28 days ending a quarter ago. A week-on-week check cannot see a slow bleed: blogs.manageengine.com fell from 7,684 clicks/month to 0 across nine months without any single week breaching a threshold.

thresholds._note: Minimum absolute movements exist because a percentage on a small base is noise: a page going 3 clicks -> 1 is a 67% drop and means nothing.
